s1.content:
Sign with Oak Fit Cabinetry. Their revised quote (Oct 28) is $920 labour against Pine Build's $1,100, their license is active while Pine Build's is still pending, and Pine Build wants 50% ($550) up front, which is above what California allows for a deposit. With Oak you owe $92 (10%) on signing and the $828 balance only when you sign off the finished job.

The signed drawing (Oct 30) calls for H35-A: 35 mm cup, full overlay, soft-close hinges for frameless cabinets, ten hinges, so one pack of 5 pairs. Ignore the Oct 20 draft.

I've saved this for when you sign.
